1. Heard on misc. application No.01/23 for taking compromise deed on record.
2. For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
The compromise deed is taken on record.

3. By way of these criminal misc. petitions under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the accused-petitioners have approached this Court with a prayer to quash the FIR No.137/2023 registered at Police Station Moti Dungri, District [2023:RJ-JP:30864] (3 of 3)
[CRLMP-6809/2023] Jaipur (East) for the offences punishable under Sections 384, 420, 406, 467,
468, 471 & 120-B of IPC.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that during pendency of the investigation, the petitioners have entered into a compromise with the complainant.
The written compromise has been filed in these petitions.
5. Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant do not dispute the aforesaid factual position.

6. In view of the aforesaid and considering the submissions made on behalf of the respective parties;
the material made available for my perusal; considering that the parties have resolved their dispute and also finding that the present case is wholly covered by the principle of law laid down by Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr-reported in 2012 Cr.L.J. (SC)
4934 and in the case of State of Haryana & Ors. Vs. Choudhary Bhajan Lal & Ors. [AIR 1992 SC 604]
and as such, the aforesaid FIR is liable to be quashed in view of compromise arrived at between the parties.

sentences.text: 7. In view of the above, these criminal misc. petitions are allowed and the FIR No.137/2023 registered at Police Station Moti Dungri, District Jaipur (East) is quashed and set aside.
Consequence to follow.
